records.text: FoldAR released the Victor Marx Signature Series rifle at the 2024 SHOT Show, where the Marxes attended the booth for several hours on each of the show's four days.
records.speaker: Corby Hall

appearances.snippet: Following our initial meeting with the Marxes, we released the Victor Marx Signature Series rifle at the SHOT Show in 2024. ... The Marxes participated in the release, attending our show booth for several hours each of the four days of the show.

verification.notes: FoldAR publicly marketed a Victor Marx Signature Series, contemporaneous material places the Marx team at SHOT Show 2024, and Hall later described preparing and displaying the series there. Hall is the principal source for the claim that the Marxes spent several hours at the booth on all four days.

sources.title: FoldAR post: Victor Marx Signature Series
sources.relevance: Official FoldAR post confirms the Victor Marx Signature Series was publicly offered.

sources.title: Candace Episode 329 transcript with Corby Hall
sources.relevance: Hall describes preparing the series for SHOT Show 2024 and displaying it there.

records.text: Victor Marx said he was willing to sit down with Candace Owens if he could bring his wife, Eileen Marx, and Corby Hall was not present.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He is claiming that he is willing to sit down with me, but he's got some conditions. One of the conditions is that he wants to be able to bring his wife, Eileen (Eileen Marx), but he does not want Corby Hall to be present.

verification.notes: The claim concerns private conditions Victor Marx allegedly set for an interview. The episode attributes those conditions to him, but live searches found no direct statement, correspondence, or independent reporting that authenticates the wife-present and Corby-Hall-absent terms. Unable to verify from current public sources.

records.text: Candace Owens said she was willing to interview Victor Marx with Eileen Marx if Corby Hall also participated, or to interview Marx alone virtually.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I am happy, just to be clear, to have Victor (Victor Marx) on with his wife. If he'd like to have her, I have no problem with that. But we will need him to agree to sit down with Corby Hall because he sent me a ton of messages and I would like to begin to sort through them. Otherwise, I am happy to have just Victor (Victor Marx) on my show alone one-on-one.

verification.notes: The primary episode records Owens offering to interview Marx with Eileen present if Corby Hall also joined, or to interview Marx alone virtually. This directly verifies the promise as stated.
